def typed_dict_from_dict(d: TypeDict) -> type:
    module = d["module"]
    qualname = d["qualname"]
    elem_types = d.get("elem_types", {})
    annotations = {k: type_from_dict(v) for k, v in elem_types.items()}
    # Get the class name (last part of qualname)
    name = qualname.split(".")[-1]
    # Create a new TypedDict type dynamically
    typed_dict_class = TypedDict(name, annotations)  # type: ignore[misc]
    typed_dict_class.__module__ = module
    typed_dict_class.__qualname__ = qualname
    return typed_dict_class
